description: Lokacije hidrantov v Bistrici ob Sotli is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA BISTRICA OB SOTLI. The database contains information on the locations of hydrants in Bistrica ob Sotli. The following data are included: name of hydrant/location, fire brigade area, type, connector-pipes, pressure. Coverage: OBČINA BISTRICA OB SOTLI. The portal shows the English title as "Locations of hydrants in Bistrica ob Sotli" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA BISTRICA OB SOTLI. Its keywords include gasilni sistemi. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
